promotion_notes.all: Points and full weeks at rank produce next-rank candidates only. Require accepted deliverables relevant to the next rank and human-approved next-rank acceptance requirements. Normally advance one rank; each promotion requires separate human approval.
promotion_notes.上等兵: At least one qualifying contribution report.
promotion_notes.下士: No unresolved, confirmed serious violation; suspicion is not a confirmed violation.
promotion_notes.中士: Qualifying delivery in each of the last two closed cycles.
promotion_notes.上士: At least one qualifying Third-Class Merit or Second-Class Merit asset award. Grade prerequisites count only solo awards, or lead participation with nominal share at least 60% and positive posted points.
promotion_notes.少尉: At least one qualifying Second-Class Merit or two qualifying Third-Class Merits, subject to the same grade-prerequisite counting rule.
promotion_notes.中尉: Expanded responsibilities confirmed by the human.
promotion_notes.上尉: At least one qualifying First-Class Merit or two independent qualifying reused assets; a parent asset and its derivatives count as one.
promotion_notes.少校: Approved vacant seat and human selection; unconfigured seats do not imply vacancies.
promotion_notes.中校: Approved seat and human selection only, without automatic point-based promotion.
promotion_notes.exception: A First-Class Merit exception allowing one rank early is limited to once per bot per calendar quarter. Honor-based exceptions require separate approval and available seats. The v0.2.0 scripts produce manual proposals only and do not execute exceptions.
promotion_notes.special_rank: Marshal is a human-appointed special rank with zero to one seat, recorded separately from the Commander role. It grants no points, does not change ordinary rank or time-at-rank start, and creates no self-approval authority.
